{{WP|Tokyo|'''Tokyo'''}} is the capital city of [[Japan]].

==Role in the ''Grand Theft Auto'' Series==
*According to the [http://www.rockstargames.com/grandtheftauto3/flash/francisAirport/index.html original ''GTA III'' website], Tokyo is one of the destinations of the [[Francis International Airport (3D Universe)|Francis International Airport]].
*Tokyo is briefly mentioned in [[Liberty Tree Editorial/Yakuza Operating With Impunity|a Liberty Tree article]].
*Flight NG 010 to Tokyo is listed as departing at 11:40 A.M in the cutscene [[Interiors in GTA San Andreas|interior]] of [[Los Santos International Airport (3D Universe)|Los Santos International Airport]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.
*Tokyo is mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]]'' as the setting for the push-up contest featured in [[Push-Up - The Movie]], mistakenly referred to as being in China by the presenter.
*The satirical anime [[Princess Robot Bubblegum]] is set in "Futuristic Tokyo".

==Trivia==
*A [[Grand Theft Auto: Tokyo|''Grand Theft Auto'' game set in Tokyo]] was one of several titles that Rockstar had planned to produce after the release of ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]''. The game appears to have entered active development on the PS2 at one point, but eventually, it was cancelled as Rockstar struggled with the logistics of maintaining an active development team in Tokyo.
